title: Preparing Financial Statements and the Annual Report
overview: Financial statements and the annual report are essential tools for communicating a company’s financial health and performance to stakeholders. This course is designed to equip participants with the skills to prepare financial statements in compliance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS), ensuring transparency, accuracy, and credibility in financial reporting.
audience: This course is ideal for senior and junior accountants, accounting and finance professionals, chief accountants, accounting managers and supervisors, financial controllers, and anyone looking to enhance or update their skills in preparing financial statements and related notes.
methodology: The course combines theoretical concepts with practical applications, introducing participants to Excel for financial statement preparation. Participants will also engage with real-world case studies and deliver presentations to reinforce their learning.
competencies: Designing and managing chart of accounts
Preparing and analyzing financial statements (income, balance sheet, cash flow)
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Explain the components and process of the accounting cycle.
Design and maintain an effective chart of accounts.
Perform accounting adjustments, including deferrals and accruals.
Create trial balances and adjusted trial balances.
Map charts of accounts to financial statements accurately.
Prepare and present income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements.
Formulate detailed notes to accompany financial statements.
